claims.summary: The Russian pronoun 'они' means 'they/them' and in genitive case its form is 'их'; after many prepositions, it appears as 'них'.

The genitive case is a grammatical case used in various constructions. Without a preposition, 'их' can appear. After prepositions like 'от' or 'у', third-person personal pronouns typically add '-н-': 'от них', 'у них'.
The article provides examples of the pronoun 'они' in genitive case after prepositions: 'Это письмо от них', 'Я получил сообщение от них', 'У них есть время'.
